sections.h2: Stoney Creek Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 80 residential sales closed in Stoney Creek (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $744,520, well above the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 4 days to sell, faster than the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Stoney Creek sales closed between $720,983 and $781,112, or about $240 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($757,580, 43 sales) was about 4% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($729,480, 37 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Stoney Creek
sections.html: 100% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Chesapeake the figure is 24%. The median Stoney Creek home is about 3,208 square feet, larger than the 1,970 square foot citywide median. 99% of Stoney Creek sales had four or more bedrooms, against 53% citywide.

sections.h2: When Stoney Creek Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Stoney Creek were busiest in June (12 sales across the two years) and slowest in September (2 sales). Sold prices ran from $649,900 to $933,530, a spread of 1.4x between the lowest and highest sale. 92% of homes closed at or above list price and 0% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Stoney Creek
sections.html:
All of the sales were detached single-family homes. The median home was about 3,208 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 2,816 to 3,480 square feet. 52% of the homes that sold had 5 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 2024 and 2026, with a median year built of 2025, so this is mostly newer construction.
